b: Next morning we left and travelled to the coconut village.. You can go by car … We'd bought the tickets in advance… There'll be lots of agents… look around and get it cheap.. Getting out, on the way I bought a cone-shaped hat they call a "non la".. Very useful .. keeps the sun off..

Since it was sunny, we went into a shop as if to buy bottles of water, sat and talked for a long time till the heat died down, then found the agent and went in.. There we had to take three coracles, one for every two people.. One person rows the coracle.. Of us, Dhanush went in a coracle on his own.. Because some coracle men show off stunts on the water.. He went wanting them to show him lots of that so he'd fall into the water… But what happened was different

There's another thing I should tell you here ..these two boys studied at Moratuwa.. Thushara too.. I don't know if, apart from studying, they do anything there that rattles your brain.. As far as I've seen, every one of them is up and down like this.. If they go on a trip they'll capsize the boat and jump into the water, get stung in the sea… I've seen lots of their heroic adventures like this.. You never know when or why their brain will slip…All of us write an NOC before setting off, saying that if we go with Moratuwa people we'll lose our lives somewhere..

So Dhanush came alone in his coracle.. At one place a man stood in his coracle spinning round and round.. We all took videos.. They said if we went from our coracle to his, he'd spin us too.. We went one by one.. It wasn't too scary.. When Mithra went, we screamed at her to stand up.. She took no notice..

After that the coracle people talked with us as they rowed..That's when, seeing us coming in the other coracles boy-and-girl, they must have thought we were couples.. Dhanush's coracle was rowed by a lady.. Seems the moment there's a coracle, Bharathiraja turns up.. When she asked why the two of them couldn't become a couple, he got scared and explained in sign language that his partner was already suffering alone in England .. great comedy… We video-called Rami and poured oil on the burning fire, and she too worried that he was a lucky so-and-so.. In between, the coracle went off on its own away from us for ten minutes.. What happened, only he knows

After that we paid everyone and took photos of the lady who'd come for this in a Cinderella dress.. Then we went back to the same shop and sat talking.. Everyone told how they get made to work in their jobs.. how many hardships.. I understood it was foolish of me to moan all those years on campus.. Everyone has hardships ..thinking it's only me is ignorance

After that, when we went to the rooms, another fight.. Dhanush blurted out that the AC didn't work.. Another fight that they can't come upstairs again... Luckily we'd told the hotel people in the morning and the AC had been fixed.. So we could have slept nicely… But that didn't happen… We just talked late into the night .. and as if that wasn't enough we played 304 too… Ignoring us, Thushara alone went to sleep
Like this, still sleepy, we set off for Hue the next day
note: "First Honour" (Muthal Mariyathai, 1985) is a much-loved Tamil film by the director Bharathiraja, with famous scenes on a coracle. The University of Moratuwa is Sri Lanka's leading engineering school. An NOC is a "no objection certificate".
